# Fuling totem

Type: Misc | Internal ID: GoblinTotem | Source: Fuling Village, ,, Fuling Berserker | Usage: Summon, Yagluth | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Fuling totems are rare items found in the Plains.

## Usage

A total of five Fuling totems are required to summon Yagluth, the fifth boss of Valheim.

## Availability

Fuling totems can be obtained from various sources:
• In Fuling Villages, with a 50% chance next to each Bonfire.
• Guaranteed inside some variants of Fuling Outposts.
• As a 10% drop from Fuling Berserkers.
• As a 2.8% drop from chest in Stonehenges.

## Notes

• If the pedestal on which the totem rests is destroyed before the player interacts with the totem, the totem will not be dropped.
• The totem bears some resemblance to Yagluth, especially the crown. It is implied through various Runestones that the Fulings worship him as some sort of king or deity.
• Totems are fairly uncommon and are not guaranteed to be present in points of interest in the Plains.

Categorias: Misc Items, Forsaken offerings
